Excited to share that Yellove Tech Community successfully hosted YelloHack 2024 — a 24-hour hackathon that brought together 200+ student developers from across Tamil Nadu.

The event featured:
→ 50 teams competing across 4 themes
→ ₹1,00,000 in prizes
→ Mentorship from industry professionals at Google, Microsoft, and Zoho
→ Real-world problem statements from partner organizations

What made this special wasn't just the code — it was watching students collaborate, learn from failures, iterate rapidly, and present solutions they genuinely believed in.

The winning project, a Smart Campus App by Team ByteForce, is now being piloted at our college. From hackathon idea to real deployment — that's the impact we aim for.

A huge thank you to our sponsors, mentors, volunteers, and every participant who made this possible.

If your organization wants to partner with student communities for future events, let's connect. These students are building the future, one hackathon at a time. 💛

#Hackathon #StudentDevelopers #YelloveTech #Innovation #TechCommunity #Chennai #BuildAndShip

We just crossed 1,000 members in our tech community. 🎉

Started 8 months ago with 12 people in a classroom. No funding. No connections. Just a WhatsApp group and a shared belief that students learn best by building.

Since then:
→ 15 workshops conducted
→ 3 hackathons organized
→ 2 inter-college collaborations
→ 50+ projects built by members
→ 10 members placed through community referrals

The best part? Every single event was organized by students, for students. No external event management. No paid promotions. Just word of mouth and genuine value.

Namma community, namma effort, namma growth. 💛

To everyone who's been part of this journey — thank you. Indha 1000 is just the beginning.

#Community #StudentLife #TechCommunity #Milestone #1000Members #GrowthMindset

Thrilled to announce that Yellove Tech Community is partnering with IEEE Student Branch for the upcoming academic year!

Together, we'll be running:
• Monthly technical workshops covering emerging tech stacks
• A combined inter-college hackathon in semester 2
• An industry mentorship program connecting students with professionals
• A national-level paper presentation competition

Both communities share a common goal — making technical education practical, accessible, and community-driven.

Irandu communities. Oru mission. Students-ah next level-ku kondu poradhu. 💛

Excited for what's ahead. Details dropping soon.
